lesson.title: How Magnetic, Optical and Solid-State Storage Work

images.alt: Distinct physical mechanisms of HDD, optical disc and SSD.
Factors to compare when selecting a storage medium.

questions.prompt: Describe how data is stored or read on a magnetic HDD.
questions.model_answer: Rotating magnetic platters are organised into tracks and sectors. A read/write head uses magnetic effects to store or detect data.
questions.grading_criterion:
1: Rotating magnetic platters are organised into tracks and sectors.
1: A read/write head uses magnetic effects to store or detect data.
questions.student_guidance:
Describe the structure of the moving storage surface.
Explain the role of the part that reads or changes the stored pattern.

questions.prompt: Explain why an SSD may be more suitable than an HDD for a portable laptop.
questions.model_answer: An SSD has no moving storage parts and is less vulnerable to mechanical shock. An SSD generally provides faster data access/loading.
questions.grading_criterion:
1: An SSD has no moving storage parts and is less vulnerable to mechanical shock.
1: An SSD generally provides faster data access/loading.
questions.student_guidance:
Compare how the devices withstand being moved or knocked.
Compare the time needed to retrieve data from each device.
